nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf tracking user token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/batchSend/list.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] backing approve/transferFrom spending logic.
Public totalSupply constant-like variable set to 100,000,000 * 10^18.
Uniswap V2 router address used in list() addLiquidityETH call.
Uniswap V2 factory address used to derive the pair address.
WETH address used together with the factory to compute uniPair.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor; gates delegate, batchSend and list.
Cached Uniswap pair address computed via pairFor in constructor.
Token name string 'SOTA'.
Token symbol string 'SOTA'.
Token decimals constant (18).
transfer(address,uint) payable wrapper that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
transferFrom(address,address,uint) with ensure modifier; performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve(address,uint) sets allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Owner-only delegate(address,bytes) that performs an arbitrary delegatecall, executing untrusted code in the token's storage context.
Owner-only batchSend loops over recipients, with unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and duplicated Transfer events.
Modifier ensure(address,address) authorizing transfers via owner, uniPair, tx.origin or isAccountValid(tx.origin).
Internal pure pairFor computing Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 keccak hash.
Internal pure sliceUint(bytes) reading the first word via inline assembly mload.
Public pure isAccountValid(address) returning subject mod 100 == 0, used as an authorization predicate.
View helper requiring isAccountValid(msg.sender) but never invoked internally.
Constructor setting owner = msg.sender, computing uniPair and granting unlimited allowances.
Owner-only list() that repricess balances, calls addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline and distributes tokens.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled origin of transfers, approvals and owner checks.
block.timestamp used as additive deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
tx.origin used in the ensure modifier for authorization and passed to isAccountValid.
delegatecall to a caller-supplied address in delegate(), executing arbitrary code with the token's storage.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend allowing overflow of the total amount.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath.

edges.reason: transfer uses parameter _to as the recipient forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer uses parameter _value as the amount forwarded to transferFrom.
transferFrom reads parameter _from for authorization and balance updates.
transferFrom credits parameter _to.
transferFrom debits parameter _value from balance and allowance.
approve writes allowance for parameter _spender.
approve stores parameter _value.
delegate passes parameter a as delegatecall target.
delegate passes parameter b as delegatecall calldata.
batchSend iterates parameter _tos to credit recipients.
batchSend uses parameter _value in unchecked multiplication and credits.
ensure modifier evaluates parameter _from in the authorization condition.
ensure modifier evaluates parameter _to in the authorization condition.
pairFor hashes parameter factory into the pair address.
pairFor orders parameter tokenA against tokenB.
pairFor orders parameter tokenB against tokenA.
sliceUint loads the first word of parameter bs.
isAccountValid hashes parameter subject to test modulo 100.
list uses parameter _numList for liquidity and contract balance.
list loops over parameter _tos to airdrop balances.
list uses parameter _amounts to set recipient balances.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the transfer.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to spend allowance and lets msg.sender bypass balance ownership.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate authorizes the delegatecall solely through msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is gated by msg.sender == owner.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
list requires msg.sender == owner before minting and listing liquidity.
list builds the Uniswap deadline from block.timestamp, making execution timestamp dependent.
ensure authorizes transfers when tx.origin == owner, allowing phishing-style origin bypass.
ensure passes tx.origin to isAccountValid, so any origin whose address mod 100 == 0 is authorized.
isAccountValid calls sliceUint to read the packed address word.
transfer delegates its logic to transferFrom.
ensure modifier guards the body of transferFrom.
delegate invokes an arbitrary delegatecall, executing untrusted external code in the token storage context.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf and allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
list rewrites balanceOf for the contract, owner and airdrop recipients.
list calls addLiquidityETH on uniRouter.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
constructor stores the pair address computed by pairFor.
constructor calls pairFor to derive uniPair.
pairFor consumes the configured uniFactory address.
batchSend stores the unchecked product in local total.
local total derived from unchecked multiplication is the value whose overflow drains inconsistent balances.
loop-local _to is credited in balanceOf inside batchSend.
list loop index drives writes to balanceOf.
pairFor uses sorted token0 in the CREATE2 hash.
pairFor uses sorted token1 in the CREATE2 hash.
sliceUint returns the assembly-loaded local x.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to feed transfer's recipient argument.
Parameter _value only exists to feed transfer's amount argument.
Parameter _from is consumed by transferFrom's authorization and balance logic.
Parameter _to is consumed by transferFrom's balance credit logic.
Parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom's allowance and balance debits.
Parameter _spender only indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter _value is the amount stored by approve.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target exploited by delegate.
Parameter b is the attacker-controlled calldata of the delegatecall.
Parameter _tos drives the batchSend loop length and recipients.
Parameter _value is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Parameter _from is tested in the ensure authorization condition.
Parameter _to is tested in the ensure authorization condition.
Parameter factory is hashed directly inside pairFor.
Parameter tokenA participates in the pair hash computation.
Parameter tokenB participates in the pair hash computation.
Parameter bs is the sole input read by sliceUint.
Parameter subject is the address tested modulo 100.
Parameter _numList is written into balances and passed to addLiquidityETH.
Parameter _tos supplies the airdrop recipients in list.
Parameter _amounts supplies the airdrop amounts in list.
Local total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Loop index i only exists to iterate batchSend.
Loop-local _to is a temporary alias of _tos[i] in batchSend.
Loop index i only exists to iterate list.
Local token0 is a sorting temporary inside pairFor.
Local token1 is a sorting temporary inside pairFor.
Local x is the assembly-loaded return temporary in sliceUint.
